Trail Physics · Unit 2: Understanding Motion · Module 5

Vectors

Quantities with a size and a direction: how to add them, split them into components and find a resultant.

Lesson coming

The question

Ride 30 m east and then 40 m north. How far are you from where you started?

The physics

  • Scalars and vectors
  • Magnitude and direction
  • Vector addition and subtraction
  • Components
  • Resultants

The math

  • R = √(Rx² + Ry²)
  • θ = arctan(Ry / Rx)
  • Ax = A cos θ, Ay = A sin θ

Learning objectives

  • Tell scalar and vector quantities apart
  • Add and subtract vectors, by drawing and by components
  • Resolve a vector into horizontal and vertical components
  • Find a resultant’s magnitude and direction

Helps to know first: Mathematics Review.

The mountain biking connection

A rider can hold the same speed while changing direction, so speed alone isn’t enough. Velocity, acceleration, gravity and the forces on a bike all have directions.
